state.background: Phase 6 batch B10 transfers exactly three Plan45 mobile-pixel tooltip scenarios to Browser Mode: p45-b-tooltip-dismiss-138-case01 (#138), p45-b-tooltip-dismiss-159-mobile-pixel-tooltip-escape-tooltip (#159), and p45-b-tooltip-dismiss-188-case01 (#188). All use the shared __MOUNT_ALL__ fixture on Chromium Pixel 7 touch context, the production `/` route, and a live nominal `.recharts-bar-rectangle` hit target with positive box and elementFromPoint validation (up to four attempts) before touch tapping. #138 asserts cursor count >0 after the bar tap, touches close, then checks close hidden within 5 seconds and cursor count 0. #159 asserts the custom tooltip appears within 5 seconds, presses Escape, checks tooltip and close button hidden within 5 seconds, immediately retaps the same bar coordinates without pointer movement, then checks the tooltip visible within 5 seconds. #188 asserts close visible within 5 seconds and cursor count >0, touches the nominal chart heading (`消費支出（名目）`) outside the wrapper, then checks close hidden within 5 seconds and cursor count 0. Independent implementation and source audits passed. Focused Browser Mode passed 3/3; residual E2E completed build/type-check and passed 11 with 15 skipped. Starting from B09 M=112, B10 advances M to 115; 25 of 33 eligible Phase 6 scenarios are accepted and 8 remain Playwright-owned. The independent audit identified unrelated tooltip diff changes of unknown provenance: two post-scroll assertions removed from the separate P42 #231 scroll-dismiss test, plus a desktop hover-dismiss test deleted in `tests/e2e/tooltip-dismiss.e2e.spec.ts`. These are outside B10 and B11, are not attributable to B10, and are excluded from its cutover count. B11 stable ID #249's CDP swipe source assertions remain unchanged, including its final close-hidden assertion.
acceptanceCriteria: All three B10 stable IDs preserve the mapped touch interaction source assertions in permanent fail-on-contract Browser Mode tests under shared fixture mount behavior and Pixel 7 Chromium touch context.

The tested bar target is the live nominal `.recharts-bar-rectangle` and its tap point has positive geometry plus an elementFromPoint hit-test before touch; the route command retries up to four candidates.
#138 preserves cursor visibility/count, close-button touch, hidden close state within 5 seconds, and zero cursor count after dismissal.
#159 preserves tooltip visibility, Escape dismissal of tooltip and close button, and immediate same-coordinate retap without pointer movement that reopens the tooltip.
#188 preserves close/cursor visibility, touch on the nominal chart heading outside the wrapper, then hidden close state and zero cursor count.

Only these three B10 source blocks are included in this batch; unrelated #231 post-scroll assertion removals and desktop hover-dismiss deletion are disclosed as unknown-provenance changes outside B10 and B11 and not counted as transferred. The #249 CDP swipe assertions remain unchanged.

Focused Browser Mode and post-cutover residual E2E pass, and independent implementation/source audits support the cutover; ledger advances from M=112 to M=115 with 25 accepted and 8 pending out of 33.
verification: Focused run `pnpm run test:browser:phase6-b10:built` passed one file / three tests. Durable log: results/plan45/phase6/phase6-b10-browser-mode-validation-2026-09-27.log.

After source cutover, residual `pnpm test:e2e:fresh` completed build/type-check and passed 11 tests with 15 skipped and zero failures. Durable log: results/plan45/phase6/phase6-b10-residual-e2e-validation-2026-09-27.log.
Independent implementation and post-cutover source-boundary audits passed; only the three targeted B10 test blocks were removed as part of this batch.
knownConstraints: This checkpoint covers B10 only. B11-B13 remain pending and are not included in M.

Two post-scroll assertions from the separate P42 #231 scroll-dismiss test and a desktop hover-dismiss test deletion in `tests/e2e/tooltip-dismiss.e2e.spec.ts` have unknown provenance. They are outside B10 and B11 and not counted as cutovers. B11 #249's CDP swipe assertions are unchanged. This review does not infer an owner or propose restoring the unrelated changes.
The implementation evidence is focused on the three mapped Pixel 7 mobile-pixel scenarios; no broader tooltip-suite ownership claim is made.
state.outputRequirement: Choose exactly one criterion for this implementation checkpoint. Provide effective verdict, decision summary and full choice distribution, evidence tied to B10 IDs and artifact paths, any required correction with exact location, and remaining uncertainty. Keep unknown-provenance tooltip diff items separate from B10 accounting and identify their owner correctly as P42 #231, not B11 #249. Do not promote partial ownership or feasibility evidence to a full migration. If the initial choice is not valid_as_defined, follow exactly one required case-specific clarification and preserve the initial result; do not turn a non-pass into a pass.

implementation.instructions: Evaluate whether B10 is a valid full cutover under the acceptance criteria and evidence. Select the single best matching criterion.

criteria.valid_as_defined: The supplied source-contract, cutover, ledger, and verification evidence supports accepting B10 as defined.
criteria.requirements_mismatch: A concrete conflict exists between requirements and implementation or recorded evidence; identify the requirement and requirement-only correction.
criteria.missing_prerequisites_info: Required prerequisite information is missing; identify exactly what is needed.
criteria.incomplete_implementation_info: Specific evidence needed to assess B10 is missing; identify the exact gap.
criteria.implementation_issue: A concrete implementation or reporting defect violates a criterion; name the location, evidence, and implementation-only correction.
criteria.scope_violation: The cutover exceeds or falls outside the agreed batch boundary; identify the boundary and adjustment.
criteria.other: A different concrete validity issue exists; state the finding, location, evidence, and next action.
criteria.indeterminate: The supplied context cannot support a decision; identify the missing context and resolving evidence.
